angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 601,553 km at 201.91 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.9528 +/- 0.0169 mas (same row, RUWE 1.15): 201.91 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.864673 +/- 0.049715 solar radii from TICv8, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-27 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract): 601,553 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.916 +/- 0.121408 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-27 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5316 +/- 87.12 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-27 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: TICv8, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-27 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-27.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.526, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-27 (pscomppars): spectral type G8, from Béky et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011arXiv1101.3511B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HAT-P-27: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-27 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.3 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-27 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.26926, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-27 (pscomppars): age 4.4 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-27 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.4 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
